question.text: The cooking time in a pressure cooker is less because:

options.text: The boiling point of water increases in the cooker
Heat is uniformly distributed For the reaction $: \mathrm{N}_{2}+3 \mathrm{H}_{2} \rightleftharpoons 2 \mathrm{NH}_{3}$

solution.text: In pressure cooker, pressure is high thus, the boiling point of water increases, resulting cooking time is less than other open pots.
